root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before smoothing_ok() later copies the previous-scan AC-status window for the first non-scanned component into prev_coef_bits_latch, start_pass_phuff_decoder() must initialize prev_coef_bit_ptr[1..9] on scan 1 instead of leaving that previous-scan window undefined.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the vulnerable first scan, start_pass_phuff_decoder() skips the guarded previous-scan copy and leaves prev_coef_bit_ptr[1..9] undefined for the first non-scanned component. The fixed version adds the missing else-arm initialization at this site, so the same window is fully initialized before smoothing_ok() ever publishes it to the latch buffer.

nodes.state: At the change_dc predicate, coef_bits[1..9] names the previous-scan latch window for the first component excluded from the last scan, and that 9-entry AC-status slice is still partially uninitialized on the vulnerable execution.

The smoothing_ok() copy preserves the same initialized-prefix length from prev_coef_bits[1..9] into prev_coef_bits_latch[1..9] for the first component excluded from the current scan, carrying the stale previous-scan state into the latch buffer later read by change_dc.

edges.relation: The same previous-scan AC-status window left undefined on the first scan is later loaded by smoothing_ok() as the source prev_coef_bits[1..9] window for the first component excluded from the last scan.
The previous-scan latch window written by smoothing_ok() is the same 9-entry slice later aliased through coef_bits[1..9] when decompress_smooth_data() evaluates change_dc on the later iMCU row.
